name: Skins
author: Brett
description: Change skins in one place: a gallery of every skin with a live desktop and phone preview, one-tap Use skin, Back to skin, Restore to Default and Undo, for the whole hub, one app, one screen or one plugin (skin-switch@1). Every action is the same through the screen, the REST API (/api/plugins/skin-gallery/), MCP plugin commands, the CLI (skin-gallery.mjs) and voice. Nav → Plugins → Skins; Settings → Plugins → Skins; deep links #/skin-gallery, #/skin-gallery/skin/<id>, #/skin-gallery/scope/<scope>, #/skin-gallery/preview/<id>?view=phone. Voice / console actions: skin.use, skin.back, skin.restore, skin.undo, skin.scope, skin.open.
